title: 第4章  入门考核
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
第二天黄昏，陆渊下了官道，走向不远处的一座牌坊。

    牌坊约摸三丈高，正中刻着三个大字：镇魔司。

    铁画银钩，笔锋如刀，看之一眼就能感受到扑面而来的凛冽气息。

    再往后看，一片宅院依山而建，黑瓦白墙，层层叠叠，最高处的钟楼在夕阳下泛着滚烫红光。

    刚一靠近，两名黑衣劲装的守卫目光如鹰扫视而来。

    陆渊递上腰牌，守卫核验无误。

    “进去吧，顺着青石路走到底。”

    走过两进院落，穿过三道月洞门，视线尽头是一栋三层阁楼。

    镇妖阁！

    首层大门敞开，陆渊信步走入，内部是一个通顶空间。

    阳光从天窗倾泻而下，在空气中投下道道光柱，尘埃漂浮其中。

    光柱之内，是一个个栩栩如生的妖魔。

    有走兽，有鳞介，有禽鸟，有虫豸，有异怪，大小不一，形态各异。

    从地面到三楼，沿着四壁，足足上百种。

    陆渊环视四周，不惧反喜，眼底迸发兴奋之色。

    妖魔？

    不，这可是一个个词条啊！

    可惜了，如果都是自己杀的该有多好。

    “新来的？”

    忽然一道声音从旁响起。

    陆渊转过头，只见一个中年人站在阁楼外，正上下打量着他。

    这人四十来岁，身形清瘦，穿着一身青色常服，手中拿着一本簿册。

    他快步上前行礼，“陆渊，见过大人。”

    “别叫大人。”中年人摆了摆手，“我姓周，在司内任书吏一职，叫我老周就行，你的腰牌呢？”

    陆渊递上腰牌，老周接过，翻开簿册对照了一会儿，“陆渊，云安县人士，忠烈之后......嗯，对上了，跟我来吧。”

    走出阁楼，入了院子，二人来到了一间堆满卷宗与簿册的厢房。

    落座之后，老周翻开簿册，拿起毛笔，一边问一边记。

    “年龄？”

    “二十。”

    “修的什么功法？”

    “县衙发的基础锻体决，练了五年。”

    “修为？”

    “凡境二层。”

    老周笔尖一顿，眼里涌出一抹意外，“五年才凡境二层？”

    陆渊点头，“是的。”

    你还是的？
content_en:
At dusk the next day, Lu Yuan got off the official road and walked towards an archway not far away.

    The archway is about three feet high, with three big characters engraved in the middle: Zhen Mo Si.

    The iron painting has a silver hook, and the brush is as sharp as a knife. You can feel the cold breath coming towards your face at a glance.

    Looking back, we can see a house built against the mountain, with black tiles and white walls, layer upon layer. The clock tower at the top glows red in the setting sun.

    As soon as he got closer, two guards in black uniforms glanced at him like eagles.

    Lu Yuan handed over his waist badge, and the guard checked that it was correct.

    "Go in and follow the bluestone road to the end."

    After walking through two courtyards and passing through three moon cave doors, at the end of the sight is a three-story attic.

    Demon-Suppressing Pavilion!

    The door on the first floor opened, and Lu Yuan walked in. Inside was a space with a ceiling.

    Sunlight pours down from the skylight, casting beams of light in the air, with dust floating in them.

    Within the light pillar are lifelike monsters.

    There are animals, scales, birds, insects, strange things, all different sizes and shapes.

    From the ground to the third floor, along the four walls, there are hundreds of kinds.

    Lu Yuan looked around, not afraid of rejoicing, his eyes bursting with excitement.

    demon?

    No, these are individual entries!

    What a pity, it would have been better if I had killed them all myself.

    "New here?"

    Suddenly a voice sounded from the side.

    Lu Yuan turned his head and saw a middle-aged man standing outside the attic, looking him up and down.

    This man was in his forties, with a thin build, wearing a blue uniform, and holding a book in his hand.

    He quickly stepped forward and saluted, "Lu Yuan, I have met you, sir."

    "Don't call me Sir." The middle-aged man waved his hand, "My surname is Zhou, and I work as a scribe in the department. Just call me Lao Zhou. Where is your badge?"

    Lu Yuan handed over his badge, and Lao Zhou took it. He opened the book and compared it for a while, "Lu Yuan, from Yun'an County, Empress Zhonglie... Well, that's right. Come with me."

    After walking out of the attic and entering the courtyard, the two came to a side room filled with files and books.

    After sitting down, Lao Zhou opened the book, picked up the brush, and took notes while asking questions.

    "Age?"

    "Twenty."

    "What skills did you practice?"

    "I have been practicing the basic physical training techniques issued by the county government for five years."

    "Cultivation?"

    "Second floor of the mortal realm."

    Lao Zhou paused with his pen tip, and there was a hint of surprise in his eyes, "It took five years to reach the second level of the mortal realm?"

    Lu Yuan nodded, "Yes."

    Are you still there?
